papers.title: Few-Shot Learning with Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract: We propose to study the problem of few-shot learning with the prism of inference on a partially observed graphical model, constructed from a collection of input images whose label can be either observed or not. By assimilating generic message-passing inference algorithms with their neural-network counterparts, we define a graph neural network architecture that generalizes several of the recently proposed few-shot learning models. Besides providing improved numerical performance, our framework is easily extended to variants of few-shot learning, such as semi-supervised or active learning, demonstrating the ability of graph-based models to operate well on 'relational' tasks.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究图神经网络用于小样本图像分类，与有限元代理模型或生物力学完全不相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is about few-shot learning for image classification with graph neural networks, not about surrogate modeling, finite element analysis, implant design, or any biomedical/mechanical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升小样本学习的性能
summary_zh.method: 将图神经网络用于消息传递推理
summary_zh.result: 在标准小样本基准上获得更好效果

summary_en.motivation: To improve few-shot learning by leveraging graphical models and message-passing inference.
summary_en.method: A graph neural network architecture is designed to generalize message-passing algorithms for few-shot learning.
summary_en.result: The proposed framework achieves improved performance on standard few-shot learning benchmarks and extends to semi-supervised and active learning.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard few-shot image classification datasets (e.g., MiniImageNet, Omniglot).

papers.title: GPflowOpt: A Bayesian Optimization Library using TensorFlow
papers.abstract: A novel Python framework for Bayesian optimization known as GPflowOpt is introduced. The package is based on the popular GPflow library for Gaussian processes, leveraging the benefits of TensorFlow including automatic differentiation, parallelization and GPU computations for Bayesian optimization. Design goals focus on a framework that is easy to extend with custom acquisition functions and models. The framework is thoroughly tested and well documented, and provides scalability. The current released version of GPflowOpt includes some standard single-objective acquisition functions, the state-of-the-art max-value entropy search, as well as a Bayesian multi-objective approach. Finally, it permits easy use of custom modeling strategies implemented in GPflow.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提供了一个基于TensorFlow的贝叶斯优化库，可用于代理模型优化，但未涉及有限元分析或植入物力学问题。
llm.why_not_core: No FEA validation, no implant biomechanics context, no constraint handling demonstration, and no explicit uncertainty quantification beyond standard Gaussian process.

summary_zh.motivation: 提供高效、易扩展的贝叶斯优化工具库
summary_zh.method: 基于GPflow和TensorFlow实现，支持自动微分和GPU加速
summary_zh.result: 支持单目标、多目标及多种采集函数的贝叶斯优化
summary_zh.validation: 代码测试和文档验证，无实际应用案例

summary_en.motivation: To provide an efficient and extensible Bayesian optimization framework leveraging TensorFlow.
summary_en.method: The library is built on GPflow with TensorFlow, enabling automatic differentiation, parallelization, and GPU acceleration.
summary_en.result: GPflowOpt supports single-objective, multi-objective, and advanced acquisition functions like max-value entropy search.
summary_en.validation: Validation is limited to code testing and documentation; no application-specific benchmarks are provided.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文不涉及髋关节假体的应力遮挡、微动或有限元分析，与用户的研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomechanics modeling, no implant design, no FEA, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, no Gruen zone analysis, no intact vs implanted femur comparison.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究手术入路对全髋关节置换术后步态的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对不同手术入路的患者进行步态分析。
summary_zh.result: 不同入路导致步态模式差异。
summary_zh.validation: 基于患者步态数据的临床验证。

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates how different surgical approaches affect gait mechanics following total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Gait analysis was performed on patients who underwent total hip arthroplasty via various surgical approaches.
summary_en.result: Distinct gait patterns were observed among different surgical approaches, indicating approach-specific effects on recovery.
summary_en.validation: Validation was conducted through clinical gait data collected from patients post-surgery.
